versions.content: Semantics of meta-class DiagnosticAuthRole Meta-class DiagnosticAuthRole provides support for role-based authentication authentication. In particular, it supports the existence of different roles and the assignment of different rights (e.g. access a given DiagnosticDataIdentifier ) to any of these roles. The rights are defined in the form of a bitfield that is associated with a given role. In other words, the implementation of this “roles and rights” concept is that a bitfield is associated with a textual label (that describes the role).
